claims.assertion: Nai’Shara, quoting Yazhi, says beings are scalar and religious seekers pursue Source integration, love, acceptance and peace; each truth is perspective-bound.
claims.speaker: Nai’Shara (quoting Yazhi)

claims.assertion: Yazhi says logic alone cannot achieve integration without emotion and love; she attributes this impasse to Andromedan and Arcturian overreliance on logic.
claims.speaker: Nai’Shara (quoting Yazhi)

claims.assertion: She says Andromedans make poor human mentors, favoring Taygetans, Engans or Solatians as better adapted guides.
claims.speaker: Nai’Shara (quoting Yazhi)
